meta.name: github
meta.description: Use when inspecting or changing GitHub repository data with gh or gh api, including PRs, issues, comments, checks, workflow runs, releases, or repo metadata.

copy.tagline: 用 gh 命令检查或修改 GitHub 仓库数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在命令行操作 GitHub 仓库
copy.tagline_en: Inspect or modify GitHub repository data with gh
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage GitHub repos from the command line

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以运行 gh 命令来检查或修改 GitHub 仓库的数据，比如列出拉取请求、查看工作流运行、创建或评论 issue 等。
howto.when: 当你询问或要求操作 GitHub 仓库数据时触发，例如查看 PR 状态、创建工作流运行、创建 issue 等。

say.text: 帮我列出仓库 owner/repo 的待处理 issue。
查看 PR #55 的审查状态。
say.note: Claude 会运行 gh pr view 命令。

say.text: 显示最近 5 次工作流运行的结果。
say.note: Claude 会使用 gh run list 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run gh commands to inspect or modify GitHub repository data, such as listing pull requests, viewing workflow runs, creating or commenting on issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask or request operations on GitHub repository data, e.g., checking PR status, creating workflow runs, creating issues.

say_en.text: List open issues for repo owner/repo.
say_en.note: Claude uses gh issue list command to fetch data.
Claude runs gh pr view command.

say_en.text: Display results of last 5 workflow runs.
say_en.note: Claude uses gh run list command.
